categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 聚焦具身与世界模型的长时序记忆、LLM知识更新与RL探索解耦，以及Agent做科研和检索指令的实效

articles.title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
articles.zh: 永不回头：理解第一人称视频中3D物体记忆的持续性
articles.summary: 如果你在做具身智能或第一人称视觉记忆，这篇会告诉你模型到底能记住多久前看过的物体——大概率比你想象的短
articles.author: Shravan Chaudhari, William Paul 等
articles.body: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.
articles.bodyZh: 我们在这个世界里走动、做各种日常事情的时候，会碰到一些东西，可能当时用不上，但之后才会派上用场。我们能记住自己把某样东西放哪儿了，或者某个盒子里装了什么，哪怕当时并不知道以后会需要这些信息。在这项研究里，我们探讨的是一个具身助手（embodied assistant）如何通过观察一个人日常活动的第一视角视频（egocentric videos），来建立类似的记忆。我们提出了 Ledger，这是一种持久化的三维物体记忆（persistent 3D object memory），把物体的位置、它们的历史以及上下文描述都整合在一起。它能把整段录像里的观察结果关联起来，即使物体离开了画面也仍然保留，包括那些这个人从未碰过的东西。它会把每个物体的多次观察按静止位置聚类，只有在反复出现证据后才记录一次移动，从而减少定位噪声（localization noise）带来的影响。简短的描述则保留了诸如物体内容物或支撑面之类的细节。它把这些记录保存下来，之后用来回答空间问题，而不需要再访问原始图像或视频。我们的记忆系统把 HD-EPIC 的准确率从 29.7% 提升到 42.6%，把 UCS-Bench 的准确率从 33.8% 提升到 38.5%，并且在 Ego4D 物体定位上，返回预测的中位误差达到 0.99 米。我们的分析还识别出了时间持续性、上下文描述和检索各自互补的作用。我们针对 100 段拼接视频流（每段包含多个场景）的研究，进一步暴露了检索和构建两方面的失败情况。与单场景视频流相比，按场景分别构建，能部分挽回跨场景变化时损失的性能。

articles.title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
articles.zh: 在RLVR中将探索与优化解耦
articles.summary: 如果你在训推理模型，RLVR里探索和优化一直绑在一起互相拖累，这篇给了一条把它们拆开的思路
articles.author: Saif Punjwani, Micah Goldblum
articles.body: Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.
articles.bodyZh: 现在的语言模型，都是在已经训好的模型检查点（checkpoints）上，继续做可验证奖励的强化学习（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards，RLVR）。RLVR 最让人期待的一点，就是能发现新的推理策略。理论上，模型可以采样出它以前训练数据里根本没有的新想法。但真做起来，给 RLVR 加上强烈的新颖性激励（novelty incentives），效果一直有限，还可能把模型质量搞差。因为可验证奖励只能监督模型知识和行为中很窄的一小块，一旦质量下滑，就很难拉回来。于是，我们把探索和优化拆开，做了个框架，叫探索-蒸馏（Exploration-Distillation，ExpDis）。我们先训练一个或多个探索策略（explorer policies），在奖励里加一个新颖性加分（novelty bonus），再把它们跑出来的轨迹（trajectories）按正确性和质量筛一遍，然后蒸馏到一个单独的学生策略（student policy）里。学生策略接下来训练时，就不再加新颖性加分了。这个流程重复好几轮，在探索和优化之间来回切换。这样拆开之后，我们就能大胆把探索规模做大，又不容易把学生策略搞坏。在七个数学推理基准（mathematical reasoning benchmarks）和两个模型家族（model families）上，同样的实际耗时预算（wall-clock budget）下，ExpDis 都跑赢了 DAPO。而且我们还看到，pass@k 的扩展表现更好了，这说明 ExpDis 训出来的模型能生成更多样、又正确的解法。

articles.title: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
articles.zh: EngramEdit：通过条件记忆实现LLM中的解耦式知识更新
articles.summary: 如果你受够了每次改知识都得全量微调、又怕灾难性遗忘，这篇用外挂条件记忆做定点更新值得一看
articles.author: Hongru Cai, Ran Wei 等
articles.body: Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.
articles.bodyZh: 像 DeepSeek Engram 这种条件记忆架构（conditional memory architectures），会拿输入里的 n 元词组（n-grams）去查已经学好的嵌入（embeddings），从而只增加一点点计算量，就能扩大大语言模型（LLMs）的容量。除了把模型做大之外，这种架构还展示出一种潜力：把事实知识的存储和通用计算分开，这就有望在保持 Transformer 主干不变的情况下更新事实知识。但真要实现这个潜力并不容易，因为同一个事实的不同表达方式，可能会激活不同的 n 元词组嵌入，而更新那些共享嵌入，又可能不小心改到模型对其他事实的预测。我们提出了 EngramEdit，通过条件记忆来实现解耦的知识更新。EngramEdit 首先计算出目标记忆表示，让模型在多种表达方式下都能预测出更新后的事实。然后，它联合更新共享的 n 元词组嵌入，让这些嵌入在多种表达方式和多次编辑中都对齐这些目标，同时对那些被频繁重复使用的嵌入施加更强的惩罚，以保住无关知识。实验表明，EngramEdit 能通过条件记忆实现独立的事实知识更新，编辑成功率几乎完美。更新后的知识可以用在没见过的表达方式里，也能用于多跳推理（multi-hop reasoning）；在思维链（CoT）提示下，准确率几乎是最强基线的三倍。即使事实更新不断累积，无关知识和通用能力也基本能保留下来。这些发现说明，EngramEdit 把条件记忆变成了一个可编辑的知识接口，让它不再只是用来扩大模型，而是还能支持解耦的知识更新。

articles.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
articles.zh: Long-WAM：扩展世界-动作模型的上下文长度
articles.summary: 如果你关心机器人世界模型能不能扛长时序任务，这篇正对着"看太短、记不住"这个核心瓶颈下手
articles.author: Wei Huang, Bohan Zhang 等
articles.body: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.
articles.bodyZh: 想让机器人实时控制动作，就得让它看足够多的历史画面，才能判断运动和任务进展，可要是真去处理这些历史画面，又容易拖慢反应速度。我们提出了Long-WAM，这是一个模型加系统的框架，专门用来在实时控制的限制下，把因果世界动作模型（causal world-action model）的上下文（context）扩展得更长。我们的核心发现是：能拿到历史信息，不等于真的会用历史信息。历史越长，收益越大，但前提是视频基础模型是用自回归（autoregressive，AR）方式预训练的。我们先在没有动作标签的机器人视频和第一视角视频里，学会因果预测（causal prediction），然后在世界动作适配（world-action adaptation）阶段，把这套“从历史推未来”的结构保留下来。在RoboCasa GR-1上，把上下文从0.0秒增加到19.2秒，成功率从63.3%提高到78.7%；而如果初始化时用的是双向预训练，则没有净收益。加入机器人领域的自回归预训练后，GR-1和LIBERO-Long上的最高成功率还能再往上提。在LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0和DOMINO上，Long-WAM也比其他对比方法表现更好。通过流式观测编码、异步执行，以及针对硬件的加速，我们能在RTX 5090、DGX Spark和Jetson AGX Thor上部署，而且不会丢掉未来预测能力；在RTX 5090上，每个动作块（action chunk），包括未来视频潜变量预测（future-video latent prediction），只需要107.4毫秒。它在Unitree G1和YAM上实现了实时部署，支持动态和长时程操作，比如动态叠杯子任务成功率高达95%，而Pi0.5和Fast-WAM在20次试验里一次都没成功。作为一个“有记忆的执行器”，Long-WAM还能在复合任务里配合更高层的规划。

articles.title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.zh: 行动前先改写：刻画并缓解视觉-语言-动作模型中的语言敏感性
articles.summary: 如果你调过VLA机器人，一定遇到过换个说法就失灵——这篇把这个坑量化了并给出缓解办法
articles.author: Mikey Watts, Yuchen Cui
articles.body: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act
articles.bodyZh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（Vision-language-action models, VLAs）对指令的措辞特别敏感，而且并没有继承它们所基于的视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）那种语言稳健性。一个词一改，成功率就能动几十个点：在 LIBERO 炉灶任务里，对“switch on the stove”（打开炉灶）这句话，π0.5 每次都能成功，成功率100%；可换成“switch on the hot plate”（打开电热板），就只剩2%。而即使用复述增强（rephrase augmentation）微调过的π0检查点（checkpoint），成功率波动也能高达61个百分点。我们用经过统计检验的“单改词波动”，以及一种“神谕式”措辞搜索（oracle phrase search）来刻画这种敏感。结果发现，光靠换措辞，就几乎能抹平分布内（in-distribution）和分布外（out-of-distribution）任务之间21个百分点的差距。然后我们在不改策略（policy）本身的前提下，把这种敏感性降下来。因为这种敏感是有规律的，所以可以写成明确规则：我们先给少量训练任务的很多种说法打分，再让一个大语言模型（large language model, LLM）把这些证据提炼成10到20条改写规则，部署时，每条进来的指令都按这些规则改写一次。这些规则让冻结的π0在12个留出任务（held-out tasks）上相对提升16%到27%，覆盖对抗式、VLM生成和人类生成的措辞，而且提升主要集中在分布外任务上。这套流程在π0.5和LIBERO上也能复现，把微调条件下的成功率从93.6%提到97.8%。这个方法不需要重新训练，也不需要每一步都验证，还能零样本（zero-shot）用到没见过的任务和指令上。项目网站：https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act

articles.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
articles.zh: RoboJEPA：扩展机器人潜在世界模型
articles.summary: 如果你在盯JEPA这条路线怎么落到机器人上，这篇是把潜在世界模型往大规模推的一次尝试
articles.author: Artem Zholus, Nicolas Beltran-Velez 等
articles.body: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.
articles.bodyZh: 潜在世界模型（latent world models）已经展现出很厉害的本事，既能预测未来状态，也能在真实世界里做规划。但实际中，咱们缺一套靠谱的办法来估计它们的能力会怎么随着模型大小、数据和算力增长，这是个悬而未决的问题，拖慢了整个领域的进展。在这项工作里，我们提出 RoboJEPA，一个基于联合嵌入预测架构（Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture，简称 JEPA）的世界模型，训练数据覆盖了 12 种机器人形态（robotic embodiments），规模很大。我们发现，RoboJEPA 的想象误差（imagination error），也就是它潜在推演（latent rollouts）的误差，在算力上遵循二阶幂律（second-order power law），这让我们能预测模型质量，而且能延伸到远超拟合这条定律时的规模。我们还发现，下游的机器人规划表现会随着算力可预测地提升，而想象误差跟它高度相关，所以想象误差可以当真实机器人评估的可靠代理指标。最后，我们展示潜在世界模型能零样本（zero-shot）部署成机器人智能体，只看一张目标图片来做规划，在真实硬件上完成需要长时程规划（long-horizon planning）的任务。我们发布了所有模型检查点（model checkpoints），还有训练和机器人部署代码。据我们所知，这是第一个为多形态（multi-embodiment）机器人世界模型建立缩放定律（scaling laws）的工作，这些模型是在真实机器人数据上训练的；而 RoboJEPA 有 80 亿参数（8B parameters），是迄今训练过的最大 JEPA 预测器模型。

articles.title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
articles.zh: SciExam for ENSO：AI Agent能构建气候模型吗？
articles.summary: 如果你想看Agent能不能干真科研而不只是刷题，这篇拿厄尔尼诺建模当考卷来验它
articles.author: Yinling Zhang, Langchen Liu 等
articles.body: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Nino-Southern Oscillation (SciExam for ENSO) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO's statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO's warm-cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，语言模型智能体（language-model agents）越来越多地被派去做开放式科学研究，可它们的结果通常要拿已知答案、评分标准或者语言模型评审来打分，而这几种办法都判断不了一个新的科学模型到底站不站得住脚。厄尔尼诺-南方涛动人工智能科学考试（The AI Science Exam for El Niño-Southern Oscillation，简称 SciExam for ENSO）就是这样一个基准测试：智能体要拿真实观测数据，给 ENSO——也就是年际气候变率（interannual climate variability）里最主要的模态——建低阶随机模型（low-order stochastic models）。在六个小时的时间限制里，智能体先处理观测数据，自己写一套诊断量（diagnostics），写完后这些诊断量会被冻结，然后它们只能拿这些诊断量当反馈，去开发模型。接着，隐藏评分器（hidden graders）会测试模型能不能复现 ENSO 的统计特征、还原没被观测到的变量、预测留出的年份，并且用同样的方式给一个已经发表的模型打分。在十二个智能体系统里，有六个做出来的模型得分比那个已发表模型还高，主要赢在重建和预测上。那些更强模型的简化版，分别能和关于 ENSO 冷暖不对称的两种竞争解释中的一种对得上——而这场公开争论，任务里压根没提。对表现最好的系统，在不同信息条件下做控制运行（controlled runs），结果说明：它的高分不是靠记住了那份过时的观测记录，而且它拿到的信息会影响它怎么建模型。所以，SciExam for ENSO 能用来评估那种没有已知答案的智能体研究；结果也表明，智能体已经能造出有竞争力的模型，而这些模型的结构，跟科学家至今还在争论的问题直接相关。

articles.title: Your Prompt Should Do More: Effects of Retrieval Instructions in Embedding Models
articles.zh: 你的Prompt应该做更多：检索指令在嵌入模型中的作用
articles.summary: 如果你还在裸用embedding模型做RAG，这篇提醒你查询端的指令写法对检索效果影响不小
articles.author: Amanda Myntti, Jenna Kanerva 等
articles.body: Prompted embedding models have recently received increasing attention, particularly for retrieval, where detailed retrieval instructions are provided as part of the retrieval prompt. Several new datasets and studies have examined this setting, showing that the current embedding models often struggle to follow such instructions reliably. In this paper, we study the mechanism of how instructions actually affect the representations of retrieval queries in asymmetric retrieval tasks. We show that models can fail to follow even simple task instructions when query-side distractors are included in the evaluation. We hypothesize that this behavior is driven by the training setup of current embedding models and their evaluation, and show that fine-tuning with added query-side distractors leads to substantial improvements, with minimal effect on other tasks.
articles.bodyZh: 最近，带提示的嵌入模型（prompted embedding models）越来越火，特别是在检索（retrieval）任务里——大家会把很细的检索指令塞进检索提示（retrieval prompt）里。围绕这个设定，已经有好几个新数据集和研究做过检验，结论是：现在的嵌入模型（embedding models）经常没法可靠地听这些指令的话。这篇论文里，我们要弄清楚的是，在非对称检索任务（asymmetric retrieval tasks）中，指令到底是怎么作用到检索查询（retrieval query）的表示（representations）上的。我们发现，只要评估时在查询这一侧加入干扰项（query-side distractors），模型连很简单的任务指令都可能不照做。我们猜测，这跟当前嵌入模型的训练设置以及评估方式有关；并且我们证明，如果在微调（fine-tuning）时加入查询侧干扰项，效果会大幅提升，同时对其他任务几乎没什么影响。
